chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Hamran, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, who said: Imam Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Is religion anything but love?'
Say, [O Muhammad], 'If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.'

key_terms.يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ: He will forgive you your sins

ai.seo_question: What is the essence of religion according to Imam al-Sadiq (as)?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (as) equating the essence of religion (*al-din*) with love (*al-hubb*), establishing a core tenet of Shia gnosis where intellectual belief is validated by emotional attachment. By citing Quran 3:31, the Imam clarifies that this love is not merely sentimental but is proven through practical obedience to the Prophet, which in turn elicits divine love and forgiveness. This narration underscores the Shia view that *ma'rifah* (knowledge) and *hubb* (love) are inseparable components of true faith.
